caption:
Five shots, one element: water.

Asian elephants communicate with low rumbles that are barely audible to us but can carry for more than 3 km to other elephants.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo, Britannica, NOAA Fisheries.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Video-led showcase (elephant + two kingfisher clips) with a split comparison mid-reel; the Pinnawala elephants are captive, so the text states a general fact, not wild behaviour.
